I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

Now the build files.

Looks writable; I'll retry the write.

Now I'll test a default build, VPATH, install, and distcheck on a copy.

Now a script that runs all the verification scenarios.

The static failure is my script linking without `--static`, which the docs say is needed. I'll fix the script and rerun.

Check the rel build's installed library name, the exported symbols, and the data dir compiled into the binary. Then I'll run distcheck and the tarball rebuild.

distcheck passes and the tarball rebuilds. I'll rerun the remaining configurations on the final files and then test an in-tree build.

The first grep printed nothing, so I'll rerun those three configurations and look at the output.

The build now works in every configuration you listed, but one point in `docs/BUILDING.md` conflicts with the repo, and I followed the repo. I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I ran each configuration from a clean copy of `/app` with `autoreconf -fi` and a VPATH build. I did the checks below in each one:
- **Default, `--disable-shared`, `--libdir=…/lib64` with another `--datarootdir`, `--disable-tool`:** `make`, `make check`, `make install DESTDIR`, `make uninstall DESTDIR` (no files left over). `isodur` and `durfmt` run from the copied prefix, and a test program links through pkg-config.
- **Another `VERSION` (2.7.1) and interface version (5:2:3):** the library installs as `libisodur.so.2.3.2` and the version appears in `isodur --version`, `version.h` and `isodur.pc`.
- **Default build:** `make distcheck` passes, and the tarball rebuilds after `autoreconf -fi`. An in-tree build and `make check` also pass.

The conflict is about the interface version. `docs/BUILDING.md` says it is `1:4:0` (`libisodur.so.1.0.4`), but `configure.ac` and `CHANGELOG.md` say `3:0:1`. I kept the three `m4_define` lines as they are and made `lib/Makefile.am` use `$(ISODUR_LT_VERSION)` instead of a hard-coded `-version-info`. So the default build installs `libisodur.so.2.1.0`, not `libisodur.so.1.0.4`. Following the doc would break the ABI history in the changelog (`.so.2` since 1.2.0). If you do want `1:4:0`, change only those three numbers.

What I fixed:
- **`configure.ac`:**
  - It reads the version from `VERSION` (it was hard-coded to 1.3.2).
  - `BUILD_TOOL` is now defined in both cases, so `--disable-tool` works.
  - `data/Makefile` was missing from the generated files.
  - The `ISODUR_DATADIR` define held an unexpanded `$datadir`. It is now passed from `src/Makefile.am` as `$(pkgdatadir)`.
- **Top `Makefile.am`:**
  - Headers install into `include/isodur/`.
  - `isodur.pc` goes into `$(libdir)/pkgconfig`.
  - `VERSION` and the templates are distributed.
- **`lib/Makefile.am`:**
  - The library links the math library.
  - It exports only `isodur_[A-Za-z]*` symbols.
  - It finds the generated `version.h` in a VPATH build.
  - `internal.h` is in the sources.
- **`src/Makefile.am`:** `durfmt` is a relative link, created under `DESTDIR` and removed on uninstall.
- **`data/Makefile.am`:** `units.tsv` is added to the tarball.
- **`isodur.pc.in`:** `libdir` and `pkgdatadir` come from the configured values, and `Libs.private` names the math library.
- **`tests/Makefile.am`:**
  - `cli.test` runs only when the tool is built.
  - The cases are found in a VPATH build and included in the tarball.
  - `cases/version.out` hard-codes 1.4.0, so `make check` would fail with any other `VERSION`. The tests now run on a copy of the cases in the build directory, with that file regenerated from the configured version.
- **`m4/`:** I added `m4/isodur.m4`, which only contains a comment, so the `m4` directory exists in a fresh checkout.

cd /app && cat lib/version.c; grep -rn 'DATADIR\|VERSION\|etc/\|HAVE_\|PACKAGE' lib src tests/unit.c include | head -30; grep -n 'isodur_' include/isodur/isodur.h | head -40; grep -n '__' include/isodur/isodur.h lib/internal.h | head; which autoreconf pkg-config pkgconf
cd /app && ls -ld tests tests/Makefile.am; id; lsattr tests/Makefile.am 2>&1

rm -rf /tmp/w && cp -a /app /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | tail -15; mkdir /tmp/w/b && cd /tmp/w/b && ../configure --prefix=/opt/x >/dev/null && make -j4 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn\|error' ; make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^(# |PASS|FAIL)'; make install DESTDIR=/tmp/inst >/dev/null 2>&1; find /tmp/inst | sort; ls -l /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib /tmp/inst/opt/x/bin; cat /tmp/inst/opt/x/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc

cd /app && python3 - <<'E'
p='Makefile.am'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('# configure.ac reads VERSION.\n$(top_srcdir)/configure: $(top_srcdir)/VERSION\n','# configure.ac reads VERSION.\nCONFIGURE_DEPENDENCIES = $(top_srcdir)/VERSION\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
tail -3 Makefile.am; umask

cd /app && mkdir -p m4 && printf 'dnl Project macros for isodur (none needed at present).\n' > m4/isodur.m4 && sed -i 's|^EXTRA_DIST = .*|EXTRA_DIST = CHANGELOG.md docs VERSION isodur.pc.in include/isodur/version.h.in \\\n\tm4/isodur.m4|' Makefile.am && cat Makefile.am | sed -n 10,20p; (/tmp/t.sh sta '--disable-shared' 2>&1 | grep -v '^\./tmp/t_sta/prefix/\(share\|include\)'; /tmp/t.sh l64 '--libdir=/tmp/t_l64/prefix/lib64 --datarootdir=/tmp/t_l64/prefix/dr' 2>&1 | tail -40) 2>&1 | tail -90

sed -i 's|\$(pkg-config --libs isodur) -Wl,-rpath|$(pkg-config --static --libs isodur) -Wl,-rpath|' /tmp/t.sh; (/tmp/t.sh sta '--disable-shared'; /tmp/t.sh nt '--disable-tool'; /tmp/t.sh rel '' 2.7.1 '5:2:3') 2>&1 | grep -v '^[a-z]*=\|^$\|^Name\|^Desc\|^Cflags\|^Libs: '
cd /app/tests/cases && cat version.out version.args; grep -n version -i /tmp/t_rel/build/tests/cli.test.log | head

cd /app && sed -i 's|^cases-run.stamp: .*|cases-run.stamp: $(srcdir)/cases/version.out $(top_srcdir)/VERSION|' tests/Makefile.am && grep -n '^cases-run.stamp' tests/Makefile.am; (/tmp/t.sh rel '' 2.7.1 '5:2:3'; /tmp/t.sh def '') 2>&1 | grep -v '^[a-z]*=\|^$\|^Name\|^Desc\|^Cflags\|^Libs: ' | grep -v '^\./tmp'

ls /tmp/t_rel/prefix/lib; nm -D --defined-only /tmp/t_def/prefix/lib/libisodur.so | awk '{print $3}' | tr '\n' ' '; strings /tmp/t_l64/prefix/bin/isodur | grep units -m3; strings /tmp/t_l64/prefix/bin/isodur /tmp/t_l64/prefix/bin/.libs/isodur 2>/dev/null | grep '/tmp/t_l64' | head -3;
